milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining white_wool blocks (with shears or bare hands) drops white_wool items directly into the player's inventory. Requires min_count=2 since that's the minimum needed to craft white_carpet in the next step. Player starts with 0 wool in inventory.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate to the oak hut and visually locate the spruce_button on the interior west wall. Target (8,2,9) matches the setblock command placement. max_distance=5 ensures player is near/inside the small 3x3 hut. facing_tolerance=75° (per CommonSense recommendation) accounts for tight interior while confirming the player is oriented toward the button.

Uses inventory_has because the crafted lime_carpet item ends up in the player's inventory. The player starts with no carpet of any kind. Crafting path is: 2 white_wool → white_carpet, then 1 white_carpet + 1 lime_dye → 1 lime_carpet. min_count=1 matches the expected single output of the dye recipe.
